test_scenarios.title: Password Reset Failure During Migration
test_scenarios.description: Customer at user.account@example.com unable to reset password, getting error: 'Reset token invalid'. Issue occurred after Nov 1 CIAM migration. User works in support team.

test_scenarios.title: Account Access Blocked Post-Migration
test_scenarios.description: Employee employee.user@example.com reports: 'I can't access the support portal after the system migration on Nov 1. Keep getting 403 Access Denied error.' Verified email exists in SFDC.

test_scenarios.title: SSO/Okta Login Failure
test_scenarios.description: Remote worker remote.worker@example.com experiencing SAML redirect loop when attempting to login via Okta. Gets redirected back to login page repeatedly. No browser errors, just infinite loop.

test_scenarios.title: Missing Entitlements/Permissions
test_scenarios.description: Contractor contractor.account@example.com can login fine but cannot access Academy portal. Other team members can access. Check if entitlements were synced correctly for this user post-migration.

test_scenarios.title: Account Not Found in New System
test_scenarios.description: New employee new.joiner@example.com was hired on Oct 30 and needs portal access. Account does not exist in the new CIAM system post-migration. Please create account.

test_scenarios.title: Duplicate Account Entries
test_scenarios.description: User multiple.accounts@example.com reports seeing two portal accounts. Both accounts appear to exist. Migration may have created duplicates. Please consolidate.

test_scenarios.title: Account Deactivation Status
test_scenarios.description: Former employee former.employee@example.com who left in September is still able to login to support portal. Account should be deactivated. Please verify account status.

test_scenarios.title: Birthright Entitlements Question
test_scenarios.description: Manager team.lead@example.com asking: 'What portals and access should a Netskope contractor have?' Looking for documentation on birthright entitlements and expected roles.

test_scenarios.title: Sync Not Running
test_scenarios.description: Support ticket indicates that user sync.issue@example.com has not received updated entitlements in 48 hours. Last sync appears to be from 2 days ago. Birthright sync may not be running.

test_scenarios.title: Vague Issue - Insufficient Context
test_scenarios.description: User having problem. Please fix. Urgent!

test_format_explanation.description: Full ticket description with user email, problem details, and context

key_difference: Agent 1 does NOT receive pre-classified intent. It RECEIVES Jira ticket text and CLASSIFIES the intent itself by analyzing the description.
